title: Scalable Amortized Variational Inference for Non-Poisson Buy-'Til-You-Die Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the wide variety of existing Buy-`Til-You-Die (BTYD) models, nearly all rely upon the convenient assumption of transactions following a Poisson process. As modern customer bases grow larger and more diverse, a major gap in the marketing literature is BTYD models that can account for heterogeneity in timing patterns across millions of customers. This paper addresses that gap, introducing a family of models that assume transactions follow a Weibull renewal process and developing a highly scalable scheme for parameter estimation based on an amortized variational inference procedure. The proposed model fits to a proprietary dataset of 5 million online retail customers in 8 minutes which would take the current state-of-the-art an estimated 3-4 days. translated_title: 可扩展的摊销变分推断用于非泊松“买至死亡”模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19022v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管现有的“买至死亡”（BTYD）模型种类繁多，但几乎所有模型都依赖于交易遵循泊松过程的便捷假设。随着现代客户群规模不断扩大且日益多样化，市场营销文献中的一个主要空白是能够解释数百万客户时间模式异质性的BTYD模型。本文填补了这一空白，引入了一类假设交易遵循威布尔更新过程的模型，并开发了一种基于摊销变分推断程序的高度可扩展参数估计方案。所提出的模型在8分钟内拟合了一个包含500万在线零售客户的专有数据集，而当前最先进的方法预计需要3-4天。我们从理论和实证两方面表明，这种计算性能的显著提升不会对模型解释或预测性能产生明显影响。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于威布尔更新过程的BTYD模型，利用摊销变分推断实现了对大规模客户数据的高效参数估计，计算速度提升数千倍且不损失预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a BTYD model based on Weibull renewal processes, leveraging amortized variational inference for scalable parameter estimation, achieving thousands-fold speedup without compromising predictive performance.
